label: conj:weak-symmetric-normalization
title: Weak-sector symmetric-channel Plancherel normalization $\mathcal{N}_{\rm sym}(q)$
html:
The symmetric-channel normalization \mathcal{N}_{\rm sym}(q) evaluates the Plancherel-weighted character product across the electroweak symmetric channel:

  \mathcal{N}_{\rm sym}(q)
  \;=\;
  \frac{q^4 + q^6 + q^8}{3}
  \;=\;
  \frac{q^4 (1 + q^2 + q^4)}{3}.

The non-degenerate trace uniformizes across the 1-dimensional sym/alt blocks. The resulting expression is a closed-form rational with no free parameters.

However, the direct cell-content trace now supersedes this Plancherel-weighted formulation. The structural input is isolated to the bar-self-dual cell trace itself, bypassing Plancherel weights.

The polynomial and its factored form are unconditional algebra. Reading it as the electroweak symmetric-channel weight uses two inputs. The first is proved: by weak-sector spectral completeness, the electroweak content generated by the carriers lies in the commutative subalgebra H_2(q)^{\otimes 3} \subset H_6(q) generated by \sigma_1, \sigma_3, \sigma_5 (three commuting copies of the pair e^+, e^-), with equality when q^{2k} - q^{-2k} is a unit for k = 2, 3, 4. The second is open: by the torus-link identification, the carriers are exactly T(2,4), T(2,6), T(2,8). The reading is not derived from these inputs.

The symbol \mathcal{N}_{\rm sym} also appears in the categorical electroweak action on the substrate, where it denotes a different quantity, the Frobenius trace \mathrm{tr}_F(e_{\rm sym}^{\rm EW} \cdot e_H), recorded there with three candidate values [4]_q^2\,[6]_q, 2\,[4]_q + [6]_q and [4]_q\,[6]_q, none adopted; it is not (q^4 + q^6 + q^8)/3.
heading: Conjecture
